senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be smooth, rounded; to be pleasing, good, cheerful.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (play on <he>שִׁפְרָה</he>) <he>ששָׁפְרוּ מעשיה וכ׳</he> her deeds were pleasing before God.

senses.gloss: to cleanse, make pleasing; to conciliate, harmonize.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 11b:12">Sot. 11ᵇ</cite>; Ex. R. l. c. the Lord sent an angel from on high <he>ומנקה אותם ומְשַׁפֵּר אותם … שׁמְשַׁפֶּרֶת וכ׳</he> (not <he>ומשפיר</he>) who cleansed them and made them good-looking, like a midwife that cleanses an infant. Ib. <he>שהיתה משפרת על וכ׳</he> she smoothed over her daughter’s words, and pacified (the king) for her.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:17">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (ref. to <he>אמרי שפר</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:21">Gen. XLIX, 21</cite>) <he>אמרי שופר שהן משַׁפְּרִין אמרין וכ׳</he> words of the Shofar, for they harmonize the words that were given with sounding the Shofar &c. (the Torah).

<cite ref="Genesis 49:21">Ib.</cite> <he>ורץ … ושי׳ על ידו</he> (not <he>ידן</he>) Naphtali ran like a hind and brought the document (of the purchase of the cave of Machpelah) from Egypt, and through it he pacified (the Hittites).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99:12">Gen. R. s. 99</cite>, end (ref. to Gen. l. c.) [read:] <he>והם מכבדין … ומשפרין דבריהם</he> they offer kings their fruits and speak pleasing words; Tanḥ. Vayḥi 13 <he>ומשמירין</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:6">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 81:4">Ps. LXXXI, 4</cite> <cite ref="U00509"><he>שופר</he></cite>) <he>בחדש הזה שַׁפְּרוּ מעשיכם</he> in this month (Tishri) cleanse your deeds; <he>אם שִׁפַּרְתֶּם וכ׳</he> if you cleanse your deeds, I will &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be made neat-looking, be adorned. Y. Sabb. X, end, 12ᵈ העושה … לִישָּׁפֵר who makes a strap (for an animal) … to be adorned with it; Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. IV, 13 לשַׁפֵּר (Pi.).
